churches.assessment: Bel Air Church (formerly Bel Air Presbyterian Church) is the historic Presbyterian congregation on Mulholland Drive in Los Angeles, founded 1956. Ronald and Nancy Reagan joined as official members after leaving the White House in 1989 and worshiped there until their deaths. Donn D. Moomaw, the long-time former senior pastor, gave the invocation at President Reagan's first inauguration in 1981 and presided at his funeral. Bel Air did not depart to ECO during the 2012-2015 PCUSA exodus when over 100,000 conservative PCUSA members left for ECO: A Covenant Order of Evangelical Presbyterians — Bel Air stayed PCUSA, which institutionally has departed from biblical authority on sexual ethics and ordains women as elders and pastors at every level. Current senior pastor is Rev. Dr. Drew Sams. Per MOOP rubric this is RED at the denominational level; included for situational awareness about Ronald Reagan's home church.
churches.denomination_detail: PCUSA — stayed with the denomination through the 2012-2015 ECO departure wave; rebranded "Bel Air Church" but remains PCUSA.
churches.gender_detail: PCUSA permits women at all levels of ordination; egalitarian.
